passage: Among technologies, video gaming is one of the most heavily studied in relation to empathy.
Because worries about violent games and youth have lasted for decades, the topic has drawn extensive research.
A healthy reaction to witnessing violence includes negative emotions and physiological arousal tied to fear or disgust.
With repeated exposure, as in violent gaming, that natural reaction can become blunted — a process called desensitization.
The next step would be weaker emotional responses to violence.
Such weakened responses can interfere with recognizing and sympathizing with others.
This, in turn, can lead to reduced empathy.
A large body of work links heavy violent gaming with lower empathy in people.
choices: why video games are the most popular form of entertainment today
how game designers create realistic physiological arousal in players
how repeated exposure to violent video games can erode players' empathy
why empathy is unrelated to the kinds of media people consume
how educational games improve children's emotional intelligence
theme.explanation_ko: 폭력적 게임에 반복 노출되면 둔감화가 일어나고 감정 반응이 약해져 공감이 줄어든다는 내용. ③이 주제.
theme.distractor_ko: ①인기, ②현실적 각성 연출, ④무관함, ⑤교육용 게임의 효과는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We cannot ignore what decades of research reveal about violent video games.
Witnessing violence should normally trigger negative emotions and bodily arousal linked to fear or disgust.
But when that violence is experienced again and again, the natural reaction grows blunted.
This desensitization is not harmless, for it sets a troubling process in motion.
We must recognize that the next step is a weakening of emotional responses to violence.
Once those responses fade, the ability to sympathize with others is undermined.
We should therefore treat repeated exposure to game violence as a real threat to empathy.
Substantial evidence ties heavy violent gaming to reduced empathy in players.
choices: 비디오 게임은 청소년의 학습 능력을 향상시킨다.
폭력에 대한 감정 반응은 훈련으로 강화할 수 있다.
게임 연구는 신뢰할 만한 결론을 내리지 못한다.
공감 능력은 타고나는 것이며 환경의 영향을 받지 않는다.
폭력적 게임에 대한 반복 노출은 공감을 위협하므로 진지하게 다뤄야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 폭력적 게임 반복 노출이 둔감화 → 감정 반응 약화 → 공감 저하로 이어지므로 진지하게 다뤄야 한다는 주장. ⑤.
claim.distractor_ko: ①학습 향상, ②반응 강화, ③연구 무용론, ④공감 선천론은 본문 주장과 다르다.

passage: Video gaming and empathy have been studied together more than almost any other technology pairing.
Normally, seeing violence stirs negative emotions and arousal connected to fear or disgust.
Repeated exposure to such violence, as in violent games, can dull this reaction.
Scientists call this dulling process desensitization.
The next step is that emotional responses to violence grow weaker.
Weaker responses make it harder to recognize and sympathize with others.

Research consistently links heavy violent gaming with lower empathy.

폭력적 게임에 반복 노출되면 둔감화를 거쳐 공감이 줄어든다.

title.distractor_ko: ①교실 학습, ②공포·혐오의 긍정성, ③게임 산업 부상, ⑤우정 형성 게임은 초점이 아니다.

passage: Seeing violence normally provokes negative emotions and bodily arousal linked to fear or disgust.
But play a violent game often enough, and that reaction starts to fade.
Scientists name this fading process desensitization.
Once a person is desensitized, the alarm bells of violence no longer ring.
The next step is weaker emotional responses to violence itself.
Such weakened responses make it harder to feel for other people.
In the end, empathy is reduced.
Research repeatedly ties heavy violent gaming to this loss.
implication.underlined: the alarm bells of violence no longer ring
choices: violent scenes stop triggering the usual emotional alarm
the player can no longer hear sounds in the game
the game becomes too quiet to enjoy
the player develops a stronger fear of violence
real-world danger is now easier to detect
implication.explanation_ko: '폭력의 경보가 더는 울리지 않는다'는 비유는 폭력 장면이 평소의 감정적 경고 반응을 더 이상 일으키지 않음을 뜻한다. ①.
implication.distractor_ko: ②소리 못 들음(문자적), ③조용함, ④공포 강화(반대), ⑤위험 탐지 용이는 모두 다르다.

passage: Video gaming is one of the most studied technologies with regard to empathy.
Because there have been longstanding concerns about violent games, much research has been conducting on the topic.
Part of a healthy reaction to witnessing violence is to feel negative emotions and to experience arousal connected to fear.
With repeated exposure, this normal reaction might become blunted, a phenomenon known as desensitization.
The next step would be having diminished emotional responses to violence.
Such responses could also interfere with the ability to recognize and sympathize with others.
This, in turn, leads to reduced empathy.
A significant body of work shows an association between violent gaming and reduced empathy.
grammar._grammar_note: ② 'has been conducting' 가 비문법. 연구는 '수행되는' 대상이므로 현재완료 수동태 'has been conducted' 가 옳다.
grammar.explanation_ko: 연구(research)는 행위의 대상이므로 현재완료 수동태가 필요하다. ②는 'has been conducted' 가 되어야 하며 능동의 'has been conducting' 은 비문법. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 최상급 most studied, ③ known as, ④ 보어 자리 동명사 having, ⑤ 명사 ability 뒤 to부정사 the ability to recognize 는 모두 옳다.

vocab.distractor_ko: ①부정적인 ②둔해진 ④약해진 ⑤줄어든은 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

order.given: Because there have been longstanding concerns about the impact of violent video games on youth, much research has been conducted over the last couple of decades. Part of a normal, healthy reaction to witnessing violent events is to feel negative emotions and arousal connected to fear or disgust.

blocks.A: The next step in this problematic process would be having diminished emotional responses to violence, which could interfere with the ability to sympathize with others, leading to reduced empathy.
blocks.B: With repeated exposure to violent events — such as what might happen when a person plays violent video games — this normal reaction might become blunted, a phenomenon known as desensitization.
blocks.C: A significant body of work, gathered over many studies, confirms just how seriously researchers now take these concerns about violence and feeling.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 '정상 반응'을 (B)가 'this normal reaction ... 둔감화'로 받고, (A)가 'The next step(둔감화 다음 단계)'으로 공감 저하를 잇고, (C)가 그 연구의 무게를 결론짓는다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'The next step'은 (B)의 둔감화를 전제하므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (C)의 결론은 마지막이라야 한다.
